About Special Products.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: Eden Market Group is a marketplace that contains many different shops.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: Wednesday is an official holiday designated by the marketplace; most shops are closed on this day.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: However, depending on the owner's wishes, and the type of items being offered, some shops remain partially open even on the holiday.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: And, some shops offer special items on certain days of the week. Keep that in mind.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: Some shops will sell different items on weekends, certain days of the week, or even during certain hours; these items are different than their usual daily items.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text:
'Wonderful Friends' and 'Strong Friends' will sell one rare item each weekend.
'Miner's Coalition' will sell the anvil for blacksmithing only on weekends.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text:
I cannot tell you what items individual shops sell, because they are all different.
Why don't you find out for yourself by visiting often?

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text:
There are many people with the soul of a merchant that would like to sell their items to people in need of such.
Eden Market Group has designated a place for such people to buy and sell.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: We provide the means for goods that would otherwise have been contraband to be bought and sold in a fair and transparent manner, working in conjunction with the merchant coalitions and adventurers.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text:
Some people mutter that Eden Market Group is a black market... Haha, what a silly idea...
We are merely a merchant coalition.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text:
A portion of our profits go towards running the Eden Group, an adventurer's guild.
You can sell the loot from your adventures here, and the profits we make go towards providing services that benefit you. We are killing two birds with one stone, really.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: Keep in mind that limited quantity items will never go on sale!

scripts.speaker: Guide
